description: findu-notification-processor: seed the activation templates (PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO + PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO as NOTIFICACION; PERFIL_CORREO_PENDIENTE + PERFIL_BIOMETRIA_PENDIENTE as ALERTA under alert_meta) plus the missing legacy codes, all in the versioned v#1 + v#ACTIVE schema with exact mapper attribute names; and add a by-code alert read endpoint GET /api/v1/templates/alertas (no new GSI). Seed script only — do NOT recreate the real table or write to real AWS. Independent of the other FEATs. Covers plan.md item 7.
steps: In src/main/resources/db/dynamodb/seed-templates.sh add 4 new seed_template calls with exact attribute names (match NotificationTemplateItem constants as the mapper reads/writes): PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO + PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO (tipo=NOTIFICACION, top-level title + body_template + routing{condicion:isUserActivo,canal_si_activo:WEBSOCKET,canal_si_inactivo:PUSH}, variables per design 7); PERFIL_CORREO_PENDIENTE + PERFIL_BIOMETRIA_PENDIENTE (tipo=ALERTA, author under alert_meta: categoria=INFO, pantalla_destino=perfil_proveedor, titulo, condicion_aparicion='emailOk == false' / 'biometriaOk == false', tiempo_desaparicion=0; biometria adds cta_label='Validar ahora' + cta_action='findu://perfil/verificacion-biometrica'; NO top-level title on ALERTA).

Seed the missing legacy codes enumerated in design 7 (security: CODIGO_VERIFICACION, RECUPERAR_PASSWORD, PASSWORD_CAMBIADA, VERIFICACION_OTP, VERIFICACION_EMAIL; core: BIENVENIDA_CLIENTE, BIENVENIDA_PROVEEDOR, SOLICITUD_CREADA, OFERTA_RECIBIDA, OFERTA_ACEPTADA, SOLICITUD_CANCELADA, SOLICITUD_ACTUALIZADA, CALIFICACION_RECIBIDA, SERVICIO_PROGRAMADO) with the right tipo, migrating body/subject from current sources; only where the v#ACTIVE item is absent. Keep the existing create-table '2>/dev/null || echo exists' guard; do NOT drop/recreate the real table.

Add a read endpoint GET /api/v1/templates/alertas?pantalla=perfil_proveedor&language=es: a controller + use-case/DTO following the TemplateAdminController / ResolveTemplateUseCase style that resolves the two known perfil_proveedor alert codes via the existing findActive(code, ALERTA, lang) GetItem (no new GSI) and projects the alert_meta fields the app needs (categoria, titulo, body, cta_label, cta_action, prioridad, condicion_aparicion, tiempo_desaparicion).
Keep/extend tests for the mapper/resolve path; do not weaken existing tests.
acceptance_criteria: cd CORE/findu-notification-processor && .\gradlew.bat build completes with no errors.
bash -n src/main/resources/db/dynamodb/seed-templates.sh reports no syntax errors (no AWS calls executed).
ALERTA templates place titulo/cta/condition under alert_meta (not top-level title); routing on NOTIFICACION uses isUserActivo/WEBSOCKET/PUSH.
